avis.texte: I like this! I’m in my early 40s and was looking for an affordable face scrub to use in the shower. I selected this one and I’ve ordered it twice now. I’m not sure it has any life changing properties, but I’ve been very happy with it. It has not irritated my skin (which can be sensitive) at all and has the right amount of exfoliation for daily use, not too much, not too little. Smell is very subtle, but is nice.
Very exfoliating and hydrating . Skin feels so soft. Not too harsh on face but can feel buds. Will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: I wish I knew of this facial exfoliator sooner!I wish I knew of this facial exfoliator sooner!
avis.texte: This little hidden gem works amazing! I was looking for a new gentle exfoliating facial wash, when I stumbled on this one. Based on the price and ratings, I figured I'd give it a try. Well, I absolutely love this facial exfoliator! It has vitamin c for brightening, the perfect consistency, and the slightest tingle to it. I leave it on for about 10 minutes as a mask, then gently scrub my face to remove any dead skin. The scent is a light, super fresh citrus. The bottle itself is quite small, but a little goes a long way with this product. I think it's a great deal. It works very well, and I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective facial exfoliator. It's very refreshing! Your skin will be so soft and glowing after using this.

Not quite as thrilled with this product as I had hoped for. It has a lovely scent, but if you are looking for a little exfoliating from this stuff, it is extremely little. Miniscule actually. At least that has been my experience. Who knows, perhaps the machine ran out on my jar as it was passing through. (My kind of luck. LOL) I just know that my jar was pretty much just a cleansing cream. Precious little jar of That, too!

Found this information listed by another retailer w/exact item: The YAFUSIPE Vitamin C and Retinol Facial Scrub contains the following complete ingredient list: Main Ingredients: Water (base) 3-0-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C derivative) Retinyl Palmitate (Vitamin A/Retinol) Key Components: Mineral Oil, Ethylhexyl Palmitate (moisturizing agents) Glycerin (hydrating) Dimethicone (silicone for smoothness) Juglans Regia (Walnut) Shell Powder (natural exfoliant - creates the sandy texture) Stephania Tetrandra Extract (botanical extract) Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Peel Oil (orange scent) Preservatives & Stabilizers: Phenoxyethanol, Propylparaben, BHT, Disodium EDTA The walnut shell powder provides the gentle sandy exfoliating texture that customers mention in reviews, while the vitamin C and retinol work to brighten and smooth skin.
